Load domain files into the global environment

Source: R/get_data.r
ks_get_data.Rd

Reads one or more data files from path and assigns them as tibbles to variables in .GlobalEnv using the file stem (name without extension) as the variable name.

Usage

ks_get_data(
  ...,
  path = getOption("path.data", "."),
  type = c("auto", "rds", "xpt", "xlsx", "csv", "csvks")
)

Arguments

...

Unquoted (or quoted) domain names, e.g. dm, ae, lb.

path

Directory containing the data files. Defaults to getOption("path.data", ".").

type

File type: "auto" (detect from extension), "rds", "xpt", "xlsx", "csv", or "csvks" (CSV with KeyStat comment metadata).

Value

Invisibly returns the character vector of loaded domain names.

Details

Supported formats: .rds (R native), .xpt (SAS XPORT), .xlsx (Microsoft Excel), .csv (plain CSV), .csv with KeyStat comments (type = "csvks").

Domain names can be passed as bare names (dm, ae) or as quoted strings ("dm", "ae"); both forms are accepted.

When type = "auto" (default), the function scans the directory for files matching the requested domains and determines the format from the extension of the first match. All requested domains must use the same format.

The default search path is read from getOption("path.data", "."). Set this option in .Rprofile to avoid repeating the path in every call:

options(path.data = "/my/project/data")

See also

ks_batch_load, read.csv3

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Load dm and ae from the default path set via options()
options(path.data = "/project/data")
ks_get_data(dm, ae)

## Load from an explicit path (auto-detects file type)
ks_get_data(dm, ae, lb, path = "/project/data/xpt")

## Force a specific file type
ks_get_data(dm, ae, path = "/project/data", type = "xpt")

## Load CSV files with KeyStat comment headers
ks_get_data(dm, ae, path = "/project/data", type = "csvks")

## Quoted strings are also accepted
ks_get_data("dm", "ae", path = "/project/data")
} # }
